name: The Auction (boss: the Auctioneer)
notes: combat-spec §5 greybox arena (30x17). 6 floor lots (L: humming, locked: 'under the hammer'; the spec's 8 don't fit with a 4-tile lectern and safe edges) over a static pit (^: 1 pip + safe-ground respawn); 1-tile posts and the edges are safe ground. The Auctioneer stands on the 4-tile lectern, a solid block level with the floor (the spec raises it; raised, grounded jabs couldn't reach him, L4 report) and hops between its ends. Gallery one-ways at row 10. Exit (G) bottom-right behind a clear gate.
